灰褐或紅褐色、耳羽明顯。雄雌相近，雌鳥較大；幼鳥絨羽較多、斑紋模糊。: Grayish brown or reddish brown, obvious ear feathers. The males and females are similar, with the female bird being larger; the young bird has more down feathers and blurred markings.
灰褐背、腹部偏白、胸側橙褐，冬季在林下翻動落葉找蟲。: has a gray-brown back, white belly, and orange-brown chest. In winter, it turns over fallen leaves in the forest to look for insects.

炭黑羽色配鮮紅嘴腳，中低海拔林緣常見。: has carbon black plumage with bright red bill and feet, common in forest edges at medium and low altitudes.

深巧克力褐色的身體布滿白色斑點，尾下覆羽白色；秋天在松林間採食並儲藏松子，台灣為: has a dark chocolate brown body covered with white spots and white undertail coverts. It feeds and stores pine nuts in pine forests in autumn. It is an endemic subspecies in Taiwan.

雄鳥栗紅色頭配淡黃色額頭，常成群在水面或岸邊吃草。: Male birds have chestnut red heads and light yellow foreheads. They often graze in groups on the water or the shore.
雄鳥灰頭栗背，雌鳥褐色橫斑。雄雌差異明顯；幼鳥近似雌鳥。: The male bird has a gray head and chestnut back, and the female bird has brown horizontal spots. There is obvious difference between male and female; young birds are similar to female birds.
雄鳥灰頭配橙紅色腹部與翼斑，常成群在樹冠間飛翔，像一串火花。: The male bird has a gray head with orange-red belly and wing spots. It often flies in groups among the tree crowns, like a string of sparks.
雄鳥紅色頭頂、黑白斑駁的翅膀，敲擊枯木找蟲時的咚咚聲在林間迴盪。: The male bird has a red head and black and white mottled wings. The thumping sound of the male bird as it taps the dead wood in search of insects echoes in the forest.
高點停棲→俯衝捕食: Perch at a high point → dive for prey
鮮黃色腹部，走路時尾巴不停上下擺動，冬季常在水田成群活動。: has a bright yellow belly, and its tail keeps swinging up and down when walking. They often move in groups in paddy fields in winter.
鰲鼓濕地是冬候鳥的天堂，共有 24 種鳥。鷸鴴科長得很像，放大看清楚嘴型和腳的顏: Aogu Wetland is a paradise for winter migratory birds, with a total of 24 species of birds. The snipe and plover family look very similar. You can zoom in to see the shape of the mouth and the color of the feet.
麥克風被靜音或被其他程式佔用: The microphone is muted or occupied by other programs
黃腹黑領帶、背部橄欖綠，活潑好動。: has a yellow belly, black tie, and olive green back, lively and active.
黃色眼圈與黑色胸帶，快跑幾步、停頓、再啄食，是典型的鴴科動作。: has yellow eye circles and a black chest band. It runs a few steps quickly, pauses, and then pecks, which is a typical action of the plover family.
黃色眼睛與蠟膜、腹部白色斑點，常在山谷上空盤旋並發出「忽溜—忽溜」叫聲，專吃蛇類: has yellow eyes, wax film, and white spots on its abdomen. It often hovers over the valley and makes a "slip-slip" cry. It specializes in eating snakes.
黃褐色身體、背翼較深。雄鳥頭頂較黑，雌鳥較褐；幼鳥縱紋較明顯。: has a tan body and darker dorsal wings. The male bird's head is darker and the female bird's head is browner; the vertical stripes are more obvious in young birds.
黑嘴末端一抹黃色是辨識重點，雌雄外觀幾乎相同，台灣全年可見。: The touch of yellow at the end of the black mouth is the key point of identification. The male and female have almost the same appearance. They can be seen in Taiwan all year round.
黑白分明、長尾常翹起，鳴聲婉轉；台灣的族群多為引進後在野外繁殖。: is distinct in black and white, has a long tail that is often raised, and has a melodious sound; most of the Taiwanese populations were introduced and then bred in the wild.
黑白分明帶金屬光澤的長尾鳥，常在草地上跳行。: A long-tailed bird with distinct black and white colors and metallic luster, often hopping on the grass.
黑白分明，粉紅色細長的腿是招牌，有「濕地芭蕾舞者」之稱。: is clear in black and white, and her pink slender legs are her signature, and she is known as the "Wetland Ballet Dancer".
黑白斑紋、灰冠，雄鳥後頭可有紅斑。雄鳥後頭有紅斑、雌鳥無；幼鳥頭部斑紋較模糊。: has black and white markings, gray crown, and the male bird may have red spots on the back. The male bird has red spots on the back of its head, but the female bird has none; the markings on the head of the young bird are blurry.
黑白灰配色、長尾。不同亞種與性別頭部色彩略異；幼鳥灰褐、對比弱。: black and white gray color, long tail. The color of the head varies slightly between subspecies and gender; young birds are grey-brown with weak contrast.
黑白羽色、細長向上翹的黑嘴，在淺水中左右掃動覓食。: has black and white feathers, a slender upward-turned black bill, and sweeps left and right in shallow water in search of food.
黑色全身、額羽冠、黃嘴黃腳。雄雌近似；幼鳥羽冠較弱。: Black body, forehead feather crest, yellow beak and yellow feet. Males and females are similar; young birds have weaker feather crests.
黑色裸臉配匙狀黑嘴，在淺水中左右掃動嘴巴覓食，是全球瀕危的保育鳥類。: has a black naked face with a spoon-shaped black bill. It sweeps its bill left and right in shallow water to find food. It is a globally endangered conservation bird.
黑色過眼罩像戴了眼罩，停在高處等待再俯衝捕捉昆蟲，秋天過境數量多。: The black goggles look like they are wearing blindfolds. They stop at a high place and wait to swoop down to catch insects. There are many of them in autumn.
黑褐色、白腰、叉尾短。雄雌近似；幼鳥羽緣較淡。: Dark brown, white waist, short forked tail. Males and females are similar; young birds have lighter feather margins.
黑頂黑背、灰翼紅眼，常靜立池邊等待魚群。: has a black top, black back, gray wings and red eyes. It often stands quietly by the pond waiting for fish.
黑頭、白耳、灰褐背、淡腹。雄雌近似；幼鳥頭部較褐。: Black heads, white ears, gray-brown back, light belly. Males and females are similar; young birds have browner heads.
黑頭白頰、頭後有白斑，常小群在針葉間快速覓食。: has black heads, white cheeks, and white spots on the back of the head. They often feed quickly among the needles in small groups.
黑頭配醒目白色後枕斑，台灣西部平地優勢種。: has black heads and eye-catching white occipital spots, and is the dominant species in the flatlands of western Taiwan.
